note: Recurring studio duties (Q-134, ruled 2026-09-29). Each drain run files a card for every duty that is due, at its regular priority, whatever else is queued; an empty queue is left empty. A duty is skipped while its route is parked in surface.json or while it carries an "off" reason, and never stacks a second card while its last one is still open. Read by hq/schedules.py.
